question: Does f -> f xor q preserve the exact J2 relation for q=04000000 and 38000000?
number: Exact five-carry DP: eps 6e21be55 base=1099511627776 and both paired counts equal; eps 6e61be55 base=824633720832 and both paired counts equal
notes: Together with the high-six-bit ETA lemma and h'=h xor ((E+f) xor (E+f xor q)), this closes full coupled aliveness invariance for class toggles delta 00000040 and 00000380. Alongside the earlier 00000008 and 80000000 maps, 4/15 directions are proved; 11 remain open.
